svg.text: 24 existing schemes + 67 new drafts · simplified motifs and substitute lettering · visual review pending for drafts

svg.title: Cebu Pacific standard-livery illustration
svg.desc: Hand-redrawn standard airline colours, tail motif and enlarged English lettering on a representative airliner. Approximation, not an official brand master, type-specific drawing or confirmation of an individual aircraft paint scheme.
